g.text: Legend (SysML v2 interconnection view): frame = the part (definition or usage) whose inside is shown; rounded box = part
usage (name : definition; colour = layer: blue functional, green logical, yellow product); small squares = ports,
conjugated (~) ports on the left; lines = connections and interfaces between ports; thick arrow = flow. A box with a
need ID links to its page.
